name: Buttons
description: Solid, quiet, ghost and destructive actions, with hover, focus and disabled states.

name: Icon buttons
description: Compact chrome actions use 24px slots and 16px custom icons.

name: Diff layout toggle
description: Unified and split layouts share a reversible toolbar control.

name: Toggle switch
description: 18×32 switch; the parent owns state and activation.

name: Checkbox
description: Checked and unchecked states use the custom optical icon family.

name: Text field
description: Input plate, label, help text and validation states.

name: Search field
description: Search controls have a compact chrome variant and keyboard hint.

name: Visual option card
description: A selectable preview frame with its own preview content, icon and caption.

name: Picker
description: Selection rows and popover treatment, with a clear current value.

name: Badges
description: Neutral and active pills for metadata and account state.

name: Status treatments
description: Working, completed, warning and error states are styled across surfaces; a shared status builder has not yet been consolidated.

name: Inline alerts
description: Error and warning strips retain clear text alongside color.

name: Failure notice
description: Composer and transcript failures share a tinted, copyable notice with plain and tiled icon variants.

name: Loading states
description: The gradient glyph spinner uses the same clock, custom icon and reduced-motion behavior as active views.

name: Brand loader
description: The pulsing pixel mark uses the production Zeron loading clock and cell geometry.

name: Skeleton loading
description: Staggered list and menu placeholders from the shared popover motion system.

name: Upload progress
description: A circular progress indicator rendered for transcript uploads.

name: Toolbar tooltip
description: Delayed context on compact icon actions, anchored to the real toolbar button.

name: Popover error row
description: Shared error text frame for failed asynchronous lists; the caller owns any retry action.

name: Popover menu
description: 12px outer radius with a 4px inset and 7px item radius.

name: Command palette surface
description: A raised palette shell with shared search glyph and keyboard hint treatments.

name: Surface tabs
description: Local viewport tabs with selected, idle and close affordances.

name: Sidebar row
description: Space and session rows carry title, activity and focus states.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Nested file context with restrained chevron separators.

name: Settings row
description: A 36px identity tile, 13px title and 12px secondary line.

name: Message context badge
description: Structured context in a message becomes a compact pill with a native hover detail card.

name: File row
description: File type, change state and path in a scan-friendly list.

name: Queue item
description: Pending work exposes reorder, edit and send actions.

name: Pull request
description: Open, closed and merged status share one Git geometry family.

name: Message composer
description: A raised input plate with utility controls and a single primary action.

name: Transcript message
description: Readable message width, author context and quiet utility actions.

name: Diff hunk
description: Added, removed and context lines with line numbers and code type.

name: Dialog
description: Raised modal plane with clear decision hierarchy.

name: Empty state
description: A concise path forward when a collection has no content.
